_comment: QA 1-27 from brand/BRAND_SYSTEM.md Sec 8-10, machine-encoded. method: numeric = qa_engine computes; vision = engine emits a vision-task (crops prepared, verdict by vision model); config = checked against configs; human = user gate. layer: A config / B pixel-numeric / C vision-vs-reference / D content / E cross-slide / F release gate.
fail_policy: DNA/composition mismatches -> REGENERATE (never patch). Programmatic-element defects -> recomposite. Caps in retry.policy.

rules.name: canvas size exact per platform policy
30px safe margin on all 4 sides
brand hexes only (+tints)
exact-hex 3-zone sample on solid backgrounds; snap pass before compositing
micro-detail: repeating labels identical; widgets contrast bg; 100% zoom after any edit
single primary font family (accents per brand kit roles only)
thumbnail readability, 1-second hierarchy
engagement trio equal size (~40px), grid intact, platform policy decides presence
swipe marker identical on all non-final slides
profile block last-slide/minimal-post only; no company name/site/logo on personal brand
layout maps to ONE approved DNA archetype (never hybrid, never invented)
slide variation present, system consistent
icons/illustrations one family, recolored to brand (icon_sourcing_policy)
mascot only when character adds creativity
VISUAL HERO >=40% canvas; typography supports (singles + covers/feature slides)
type-system match: post type -> reference; reference image re-opened with vision pre-gen
hero optically centered/counter-balanced; no dead half-canvas
locked-series exactness: headline size/alignment, hero footprint +/-3%, one shared transform
reserved zones (TL pill, BR chip) empty in raw BEFORE compositing; no blind wipes
numbered list rows carry real text, never empty wireframe bars
label hierarchy identical size/placement every slide
DNA-library match before generation; tombstones DNA_16/17/19/22/25/26 hard-blocked
image-linked DNA: re-open reference image with vision before using its stage
collection templates: client-neutral palettes may be kept
json-only recipes: work from written fields; palettes remap to brand unless brief says else
device/hero geometry fidelity vs reference (MANDATORY vision compare)
headline-to-device breathing space matches reference hierarchy
inner frames/keylines >=10px clearance from branding strip
business kits source from OLD DNA json, not new collections
strip-zone background tonally continuous with artwork above (a: seam scan, b: reserve renders lighter, c: band-fill grain match)
series alignment lock: ANY repeating element x/y drift = FAIL (numeral-row-restricted masks)
typographic scale lock: size/weight drift across series = FAIL (d: model ceiling -> short-text sibling clone)

reference-locked slides match their approved master: background, geometry, spacing, palette, decorative details (Reference-Locked Generation rule 7); not_applicable with justification when no lock is active

release_gate_F.rule: all layers pass -> export; any DNA-level fail -> regenerate (retry caps); programmatic fail -> recomposite; cap exhausted -> escalate to human with audit trail
